description: Pointwise flow-law boundary traces for every flow law registered in FlowLawFactory. No grid, no time evolution: each dump row is a deterministic (input -> output) evaluation of the C++ function.

regenerate.command: cd stage1 && source runs/env.sh && instrument/instrument_rheology -dumps_dir stage1/dumps/rheology
regenerate.note: Output directory may be overridden with -dumps_dir

sample_grids.enthalpy_note: All E below E_liquid(p) for every p in pressures (E_liquid(4.5e7 Pa) ~= 416000 J kg^-1)

dump_files.meta.txt: pism revision, config file, command line
dump_files.parameters.csv: flow_law.*, constants.*, enthalpy_converter.*, energy.model, surface.pressure, stress_balance.*.Glen_exponent config keys
dump_files.enthalpy_converter.csv: E,p -> T, T_pa, omega, is_temperate, E_cts, E_l, T_m
dump_files.flowlaw_<law>.csv: stress,E,p,gs -> softness, hardness, flow + EC conversions

checks.paterson_budd_A_cold_223.15K: A(223.15 K) = 3.258e-27 Pa^-3 s^-1 (matches Paterson-Budd Arrhenius)
checks.isothermal_glen_B_averaged: \bar B = 6.81e7 Pa s^(1/n) (isothermal Glen at default T=263.15 K)
